notices.title: A new version of Lunchbox is available
notices.body: You're on 0.1.1, which can't update itself on a Mac. Paste one line in Terminal and Lunchbox updates and reopens with everything as it was. After that, updates take one click.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.8: important fixes
notices.body: We fixed some important bugs and made Lunchbox easier to use. Google's agent now runs through Antigravity, you pick model and effort side by side for every agent, themes colour the whole app, and the new Workshop lets an agent add what Lunchbox is missing, just for you. Updating takes one click, and your rooms open where you left them.

notices.title: Lunchbox 0.1.8: important fixes
notices.body: We fixed some important bugs and made Lunchbox easier to use. It downloads by itself: click Restart now at the top of the window, or quit and reopen Lunchbox. Your rooms open where you left them.
